source_title: 'Modi nahi jayenge' slogan raised at PM's Gujarat event; Congress retorts, 'you wish!'

Let the Parliament session start, and you'll see a mad rush to flee the country and the world!" he added.This comes days after Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge sparked controversy with his âModi ka baap bhi jayegaâ remark after a member of the audience interjected during his speech at a Patna event to say that âthe PM would not go anywhereâ .PM's 2-day Gujarat visitPM Modi visited the Centre at Bhildi, a 127-acre facility focused on improving the breeding and genetics of the Kankrej cattle breed. The Centre of Excellence is equipped to promote advanced reproductive technologies, with breed improvement expected to accelerate by 10â20 times.Gujarat chief minister Bhupendra Patel and deputy chief minister Harsh Sanghavi were also present.The visit was part of a wider programme in which PM Modi inaugurated and laid the foundation stones for development projects worth over Rs 14,000 crore in the state. He also released the 24th instalment of PM-KISAN, amounting to Rs 19,000 crore.Ahmedabadâs metro network is set for expansion under two projects covering the airport and GIFT City. Phase-2A will connect Koteshwar Road to the airport through five stations across more than 6 km, while Phase-2B will link GIFT City and Shahpur through three stations across 3.3 km.Another major transport project involves widening the Ahmedabad-Mehsana Road (State Highway-41) from four lanes to eight.
